notes.title: 1.2.003 Out - Minor Improvements
notes.content:
Minor updates for this version include:

- Instrument was misspelled in Zenkcraft.
- Chatlog was importing some stuff incorrectly.
- The Missing Items feature now shows the currency amounts and totals them at the bottom. Additionally you can click on the "?" Icon to copy the text to your clipboard.

notes.title: Zenkcraft Features Added
notes.content:
Recently we reached out to the community with some ideas for Zenkcraft improvements. We have addressed most of those ideas and added them to Zenkcraft. Updates are listed below.

[list]
[*] Weapon outfits will now display the name of the weapons in the selection dropdown.
[*] Gear piece names show in paper doll. A setting has been added in the options to control this functionality.
[*] Templates can now be given a "Template Group Name" from the spellcrafting screen's paper doll. This will allow you to filter all templates with any Template Group Name from the home screen.
[*] In the Character Summary report, all of the item procs and charges will be grouped together so that you can more-easily recognize what charges a template offers.
[*] A template can now be compared to another template. A summary of which stats, skills, bonuses, and resists are higher from each template will be visualized.
[*] Minor improvements and corrections to the chatlog feature.
[/list]

Improvements to auto templating and ROGify will be coming next.

notes.title: First set of improvements and new classes added
notes.content:
Recently we got some feedback on new features and improvements to be added. We will begin organizing and considering which ones to add.

For now, some improvements have been added:
[list]
[*]Added support for Warlock, Vampiir, and Occultist.
[*]In the Online Templates section of Zenkcraft, the selected template name will pre-fill. This was causing confusion since the "Import" button does not appear while the template name is empty.
[*]Minor UI improvements and fixes.
[*]Fixed a bug with the double-click opening templates unintentionally.
[/list]

notes.title: Import items via chat log is now live!
notes.content:
Zenkcraft Remastered has once again been updated to add the "Delve From Chat" import feature. You can now import items by delving the item in game. This feature will allow for you to quickly add items such as RoGs while also allowing you to vault the item after the delve.

To use this feature:

1. Ensure the path is pointing to your DAoC chat log path. This should be set by default but may need to be manually set.
2. Have the slot selected in Zenkcraft that you would like to be auto populated.
3. In the game client, begin chat logging by typing /chatlog.
4. Do shift+I on an item (or click info) to open it's stats and then type /chatlog to disable the logging.
5. The item's information will be populated into the Zenkcraft client.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42724428/f44c7e7bfbcf6f31fbb0103c564d1a5f34e345f9.png[/img]

With this new feature release, Zenkcraft will complete all major planned updates. Starting December 1, 2024, Zenkcraft’s price will increase by $1.00 to reflect the enhancements and ongoing server costs associated with Zenkcraft Remastered and its new features. This adjustment allows us to continue delivering top-tier features and content for a stronger, more reliable Zenkcraft experience.

Thank you for your incredible support over the past four years. We’re committed to keeping Zenkcraft innovative and functional for our community for years to come!

notes.title: Leaving Beta Next Week
notes.content:
Zenkcraft Remastered has been in Beta testing the last few weeks and has gone very well.

The major items finished in the last few weeks are:
[list]
[*] Online Templates
[*] Vault
[*] Gems to Quickbar
[*] Auto Template
[*] Twink Specialization
[*] Feedback from Beta
[/list]

In the previous weeks, Legacy Zenkcraft has been used for online templates while Remastered finished its core development. We will be moving over several templates from each class to the Remastered database (which is separate from the Legacy database). We encourage everyone to begin populating the new Remastered server. If you would like to claim ownership of a pre-loaded template in Zenkcraft Remastered, message Jayann in Discord and provide her your Steam Id and the template name. All templates are associated with your Steam Id which is required to upload, edit, and delete online templates.

If you have any questions about any updates or what is next for Zenkcraft, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/wpAQKH4PSa]Discord[/url] to learn more!

notes.title: Introducing Zenkcraft Remastered
notes.content:
It has been 5 years since the release of Zenkcraft and we felt that it needed an update. The community spoke and we listened. We have incorporated many of the changes you guys asked for and have rebuilt Zenkcraft from the ground up!

Zenkcraft Remastered includes the following changes and more:

- Remade the application from scratch
- Server setup file to control all settings
- Multi-server settings (under construction)
- Scalable UI in multiple resolutions
- Personalized spellcraft windows
- Undo/Redo feature

You will continue to see additional changes in the coming months as we continue to fine tune your favorite spellcrafting application! We have some exciting fun features planned that we think the community will love. More on that soon...

Remastered will be released with a config file that supports Eden however, we will release additional server configurations soon! One of the reasons that Zenkcraft was remade is that it gives us the ability to easily support any of the server's. All of your old templates will be usable for Remastered. 

[b]No new purchase is required![/b] Remastered will replace the Legacy version on Steam--  Both the Legacy and Remastered versions of Zenkcraft will be available from the Steam launcher. However, the price of Zenkcraft may increase in the future.

You can select which version of Zenkcraft launches by right clicking Zenkcraft and going to properties.
